entry_item.definition: vi. To have small spots, freckles or moles on the face
avoir de petites taches sur le visage; 2 se charger de rouille; 3 prendre de petites taches de différentes couleurs.
Sommersprossen haben oder bekommen, kleine Rostflecken bekommen; das Erscheinen ganz kleiner Wölkchen am Himmel.
To get freckles or erythema, to become freckled. The appearing of moles or dark spots in the face. The appearing of small spots of rust, the appearing of small clouds all over the sky.
